name: Time and Time Range Picker Field
description: Time and time-range picker field types.
project_description:
OVERVIEW 

 Time Field Picker for Drupal 8 module provides a two field for displaying and submitting time and time-range for Drupal site.

Here you can select different color theme for time picker like Sky blue, Iris blue theme, Parrot green theme ...etc.

 INSTALLATION 

 
 Download this module by this link . 
 Place time_picker module into your modules directory. 
 Go to admin/modules and enable Time and Time Range Picker Field module. 
 
 BENEFITS 

 - This module provide two fields Time picker and Time-Range Picker.

- Responsive

- Supports 12 and 24 hour time formats

- We provide different theme for time picker like Sky blue, Iris blue theme, Parrot green theme ...etc.
